## Our take on the #2 Premium Yellow Pencil (12/Pack)

A 12-pack of classic #2 yellow pencils, the standard wood-cased pencil for school, tests and everyday writing. The #2 core is the middle grade most standardized tests require, so it fills in answer bubbles cleanly and writes dark enough to read easily. Compared with mechanical pencils, these need sharpening but never run out of lead mid-sentence and are cheap to replace. Compared with softer or harder grades, the #2 sits in the middle: dark enough for scanning, hard enough to hold a point.

## Questions and answers

Are these the pencils allowed on standardized tests?

Yes. #2 is the grade most test instructions call for, and the dark graphite marks scan reliably on bubble sheets.

Do they have erasers?

The listing does not confirm an eraser. Plan on a separate eraser if you need one.

How do they compare with mechanical pencils?

They need sharpening but never jam or run out of lead. Mechanical pencils hold a consistent line without a sharpener.

What is a #2 pencil in other terms?

It is roughly an HB grade, the middle of the graphite scale: dark enough to read, hard enough to keep a point.

Can I sharpen them in a standard sharpener?

Yes. They are standard-diameter wood-cased pencils and fit ordinary handheld and electric sharpeners.

## Details

## Description
Create clean, readable lines with these Staples yellow #2 wood pencils. Perform math calculations, fill out test answer forms or handle other daily writing needs with these #2 pencils. The break-resistant lead ensures a smooth, seamless writing experience, while the eraser tops make it easy to correct mistakes. Each pencil features a hexagon shape for added comfort. With 12 pieces in each pack, these Staples yellow #2 pencils offer a convenient way to keep your work area stocked. High-quality wooden pencils. This pencil has No. 2 lead that resists breakage for smooth writing. Bright yellow, hexagonal barrel. 2.2mm soft lead for smooth, polished writing. Pencils come in pack of 12 and can replace pens during many common work-related tasks or projects. Top quality, latex-free eraser provides easy, clean corrections. Practical and Cost EffectiveStocking up on pens and ink remover can be costly, especially if you have a large office. These Staples #2 pencils come in a budget-friendly pack of 12 and can replace pens during many common work-related tasks or projects, including handwritten expense sheets, informal office announcements, and sign-up sheets for employee functions.Easy to UseWriting with one of these Staples #2 pencils is simple. There is no cap to remove or ink cartridge to install, and you can begin using each pencil as soon as it is sharpened. The top-notch lead is designed to remain in one piece as you write, so you won't have to worry about stray lead shavings smudging up on your documents. A rubber eraser helps errors vanish quickly and easily from your paper.Safe MaterialsIf you find yourself accidentally chewing on a pencil during your next meeting, you'll be relieved to know that each pencil is filled with PMA-certified non-toxic lead.
